en.basel-kadem: 3.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Hussain bin Hasan bin Aban, from Hussain bin Sa’eed, from Fadala, from Aban, from Zurara, from Hamran, from Abu Ja’far, peace be upon him,
with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Then, let them end their tafath» [22:29].
He said: Tafath is a man’s abstention from perfume. When he has ended his rites, perfume is permissible to him.
